home.title: Reveal your natural beauty.
home.text: Personalised skin rituals, thoughtful care and a calm space where your beauty can feel effortless.
home.introText: At Eurelia, every treatment begins with listening. We combine modern techniques with gentle rituals to create results that look like you — only more rested, radiant and confident.
home.signatureText: A 75-minute personalised ritual combining deep cleansing, massage, hydration and a finishing glow mask.
home.service1: Deep cleansing, hydration and glow treatments.
home.service2: Targeted care for texture, ageing and sensitivity.
home.service3: Natural definition with polished, effortless results.
home.quote: My skin has never looked so healthy. The whole experience feels like a little reset.

about.title: Beauty with intention.
about.intro: Eurelia was created around one simple idea: skincare should feel as good as it looks.
about.philosophyText: We believe beautiful skin is built through consistency, expert guidance and small rituals that fit real life. Our approach is personalised, calm and never rushed.
about.philosophyText2: We choose effective formulas, modern techniques and honest recommendations. No unnecessary steps — just thoughtful care designed around you.
about.founderText: Eurelia is led by Sofia Martín, a qualified skin therapist with a passion for natural-looking results and personalised facial care.
about.v1t: Every skin is different. Every ritual starts with you.
about.v2t: We focus on what your skin actually needs.
about.v3t: Fresh, luminous results without looking overdone.
